page.layout: One page of text in a single column; below the text a diagram (table-like tree) with side labels "GENEROSITAS" on the left and "MODESTIA" on the right; a catchword "Religio" at the lower right of the text block.

main_text.p: ceffus: fic etiam fuperbia, generofitatis exceffus, ac modeftiæ defectus eft; ignavia multiplicari poteft in indefinitum, capiendo duas virtutes, aut potius duo virtutis officia inter fe quodammodo oppofita, & eorum fingulis defectum ac excessum (ut in hoc fchemate fit) appingendo: patebit enim femper id vitium, quod unius excessus eft, alterius defectum fore, & contra V. G. loco liberalitatis & frugalitatis in uno fchemate, itemque loco generofitatis & modeftiæ in altero ponatur V.G.

page.notes: Diagram text is printed upside down in parts (e.g. "snjɔɔxʇ", "VIAVNƆI", "snʇɔɔjɔɔ") and is transcribed as it appears; side labels GENEROSITAS and MODESTIA are vertical. The word "Religio" is printed as a marginal-style catchword in italic; the diagram lines are approximate.
